description: This file defines a React component 'ModalTrigger' that manages the display and behavior of a modal dialog, including trigger elements (button or div), modal properties, and ref handling.

classes.name: ModalTriggerProps
classes.description: Interface defining properties for the ModalTrigger component, including modal content, behavior, and styling options.

classes.name: ModalTriggerRef
classes.description: Interface for the ref object exposing methods to control the modal (close, open) and its visibility state.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the modal and triggers the onExit callback.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Prevents default event, calls beforeOpen callback, and opens the modal.
